SMOKE_ONLY.allowed_claim: Local plumbing and schema validation completed.

LIVE_COMPATIBILITY.allowed_claim: The named endpoint/model completed the recorded compatibility requests.

LIVE.allowed_claim: The recorded live protocol ran with retained artifacts and passed its integrity gates.

missing_data_language: Use incomplete, unsupported, ambiguous, parse error, or unscorable. Never restate missing evidence as a negative finding.
